prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic 1:1 luxury fashion editorial portrait of one approved adult woman seated on minimalist white architectural stairs inside a modern studio.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural skin tones and a calm editorial expression, wearing a structured deep-blue tailored gown with sharp shoulders, long sleeves, and a flowing silhouette cascading over the steps. One arm rests lightly on a stair.
composition_elements: Subject seated gracefully on white geometric stairs with refined symmetry and a confident relaxed pose.
Large monochrome polygonal geometric portrait artwork of the same approved adult face dominates the background wall.
Minimal white and gray architectural studio palette with deep blue as the sole strong color accent.
Exclude the visible source label/watermark; preserve the artwork, stairs, gown, and clean negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting with subtle cinematic shadows, realistic skin tones, controlled blue fabric highlights, and quiet fine-art editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 1:1 high-resolution portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, refined symmetry, realistic gown and architectural texture, subtle natural grain, crisp subject and artwork edges, no text or watermark.
